name: FV_FEDERAL_ATTRIBUTES_
description: This table stores the federal reporting attribute records.

columns.name: FEDERAL_ATTRIBUTE_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for the federal reporting attribute.

columns.name: LEDGER_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the ledger.

columns.name: ATTRIBUTE_NAME
columns.description: Unique name for the federal reporting attribute.

columns.name: ATTRIBUTE_CODE
columns.description: Code indicating the Federal Attribute. This is based on the ORA_FV_FEDERAL_ATTRIBUTES lookup.

columns.name: CATEGORY_CODE
columns.description: Code indicating the category of the federal reporting attribute. This is based on the ORA_FV_ATTRIBUTE_CATEGORY lookup.

columns.name: SOURCE_CODE
columns.description: Code indicating the source from which the value of the federal reporting attribute is derived. This is based on any one of these lookups: ORA_FV_TP_SOURCE, ORA_FV_ACCOUNT_ATTRIBUTE, ORA_FV_FUND_ATTRIBUTE, ORA_FV_ATTR_SUPPL_RULES, ORA_FV_LEDGER_SEGMENTS, ORA_FV_PURCHASE_ORDER.

columns.name: SOURCE_VALUE_CODE
columns.description: Lookup code from which the values of the federal account attributes are derived. This is based on the ORA_FV_SOURCE_VALUE lookup

columns.name: GTAS_REPORTABLE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the attribute is GTAS-reportable.

columns.name: DATA_ACT_REPORTABLE_CODE
columns.description: Code that indicates whether the attribute should be reported on File B, File C, or both.This is based on the ORA_FV_DATA_ACT_REPORTABLE lookup.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
